# Jeremiah 49 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 49:1 (overlap: 23%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Concerning the-sons-of Ammon. Thus says YHWH: "Has Israel no sons? Has-he no heir? Why has Milcom dispossessed Gad, and-his-people dwell in-his-cities?" |
| LOGOS | Concerning the Ammonites. Thus says the LORD: "Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then has Milcom dispossessed Gad, and his people settled in its cities?" |
| PNEUMA | This message is about the Ammonites. The LORD says: "Are there no descendants of Israel to inherit the land of Gad? Why then are the people of Milcom living in Gad's towns?" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
